summary: Completed comprehensive testing of admin toggle feature for RE'ACTIF PRO logo link. All backend APIs and frontend UI components are working correctly. Admin can successfully enable/disable the logo link using password 'Choukette@777'.
passed_tests: POST /api/admin/logo-toggle with wrong password returns 403 with error message
POST /api/admin/logo-toggle with correct password 'Choukette@777' toggles state successfully
State persists correctly in MongoDB after toggle
Admin settings icon (data-testid='admin-access-btn') is visible and clickable
Password popup (data-testid='admin-popup') appears when clicking settings icon
Wrong password displays error message 'Mot de passe incorrect'
Correct password 'Choukette@777' grants admin access and closes popup
Admin toggle panel (data-testid='admin-toggle-panel') appears after authentication
Toggle switch (data-testid='toggle-logo-btn') changes logo link state between Active and Deactivated
When activated, logo is wrapped in clickable link (<a> tag with data-testid='reactif-logo-link')
When deactivated, logo is just an image without link wrapper
Logo link has correct attributes: href='https://www.alt-act.eu/reactif-pro/presentation', target='_blank', rel='noopener noreferrer'
Toggle can be switched back and forth multiple times successfully
success_percentage: backend: 100% (6/6 tests), frontend: 100% (all UI tests passed)
